ideas.title: Representation-first mathematical objects
ideas.claim: A mathematical object can be exposed through multiple typed representations linked by explicit maps and invariants.
assumptions: Each representation has declared semantics and scope.
provenance: Merlin discussions: coordinate systems and geometric transforms
objections: Not all representations are lossless or mutually convertible.
next_steps: Specify typed representation interface and commuting-diagram checker.

ideas.title: Simultaneous coordinate frames
ideas.claim: One geometric object may have multiple coordinate descriptions connected by transition maps.
assumptions: Frames, units, domains and singularities are explicit.
provenance: Merlin discussions: one point in 2D/3D/4D/5D+ systems
objections: Coordinate singularity must not be confused with geometric singularity.
next_steps: Build typed transition-map registry and path-consistency tests.

ideas.title: Complex and trigonometric representation bridge
ideas.claim: Complex polar form, Euler identity and planar rotations provide linked representations of 2D rotations.
assumptions: Angle convention and orientation are fixed.
provenance: Merlin discussions: cos x, sin y, i and polar coordinates
objections: Conventions and branch choices matter.
next_steps: Prove matrix/complex rotation correspondence in Lean.

ideas.title: Geometric number systems
ideas.claim: Complex numbers, quaternions, dual numbers and Clifford/geometric algebras can be compared by their algebraic laws and geometric semantics.
assumptions: Each algebra is specified independently; no blanket interchangeability.
provenance: Merlin discussions: geometric numbers and alien glyph mathematics
objections: Different algebras have different multiplication and geometric properties.
next_steps: Create algebra capability matrix and typed homomorphism catalog.

ideas.title: Eigenstructure and higher-dimensional transforms
ideas.claim: Spectral and invariant-subspace descriptions can be compared across matrix representations when basis and operator semantics are explicit.
assumptions: Underlying operator and field are declared.
provenance: Merlin discussions: eigenvalues and 3D/4D/5D number systems
objections: Matrix eigenvalues depend on the represented operator; basis changes and field matter.
next_steps: Implement basis-aware operator identity and spectral test suite.

ideas.title: Spacetime projections and periodic time structure
ideas.claim: Spacetime trajectories, observer frames, time slices and periodic dynamics can be represented with explicit projection and information-loss semantics.
assumptions: Physical claims require a specified model and observable.
provenance: Merlin discussions: block spacetime, projections and time crystals
objections: Time-crystal definitions differ between equilibrium and driven settings.
next_steps: Specify model classes and observable-level falsifiable tests.

ideas.title: Glyph-native typed mathematical language
ideas.claim: A glyph can denote a typed operation with a canonical AST identity; its visual glyph is a rendering, not semantic authority.
assumptions: Glyph IDs and semantics are versioned.
provenance: XMG-1 Glyph Foundry and normalizer implementation
objections: Current language and operators are limited; not a general discovery system.
next_steps: Extend operator signatures, symbolic patterns and proof export.

ideas.title: XMG termination and confluence
ideas.claim: A terminating typed rewrite system with locally joinable critical pairs is confluent; current implementation explores a bounded subset.
assumptions: Every rewrite strictly decreases a well-founded measure; local confluence covers all overlaps.
provenance: XMG-1C normalizer; XMG-1D Lean source; XMG-1E explorer
objections: Finite expression probes do not establish global confluence; Lean compilation remains to be confirmed.
next_steps: Compile Lean root; formalize AST size, typing and rule decrease; generate symbolic critical pairs.

ideas.title: Ideonomy as a typed idea hypergraph
ideas.claim: Mathematical ideas and multi-way relations can be represented as a typed hypergraph with explicit epistemic status.
assumptions: Missing catalog entries are not evidence of novelty.
provenance: Merlin discussions: ideonomy and idea-space enumeration
objections: Null-model scores require calibration and multiple-testing controls.
next_steps: Implement idea graph, duplicate detection and provenance validation.

ideas.title: Mathematical idea intake and evidence ledger
ideas.claim: Stable idea IDs, controlled status vocabulary and typed relations make research accumulation auditable.
assumptions: Repository intake protocol is followed by agents and contributors.
provenance: docs/research/MERLIN_MATHEMATICAL_IDEA_INTAKE.md
objections: Conversation-to-repository capture still requires an authorized workflow.
next_steps: Add schema validator and CI integration.

ideas.title: Lacunarity and multiscale morphology
ideas.claim: Lacunarity describes scale-dependent mass heterogeneity and can distinguish structures with similar fractal dimension.

objections: Not a universal engineering quality score.
next_steps: Build reproducible multiscale lacunarity benchmark with matched baselines.

ideas.title: Integral criterion for finite-time blow-up
ideas.claim: For a positive scalar autonomous ODE dI/dt = f(I)I, finite-time escape to infinity is governed by convergence of the separation integral from I0 to infinity, not merely by f(I) being bounded below by a positive constant.
assumptions: f is sufficiently regular and positive on [I0,infinity).
A local solution exists and remains in the stated domain.
The maximal-solution and escape-time argument is supplied.

Clay Mathematics Institute, Euclid Index, Book IX Proposition 20: https://www.claymath.org/euclid_index/
